question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter cluster in the same way as the second letter cluster is related to the first letter cluster.

DG : KN :: JM : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• DG : KN

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/254460a499a300d3ed9624b5b1aa350e7adb8aea8f5de900eb5019c3ff69eb9e.png] 

Similarly,

 
• JM : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6be40bb12206f0818b30d4cc0a77f0a37caddece09bcec04cd053da018895988.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "QT".
